rules: PATTERN.yaml, DATA_LAYER.template.yaml, EXECUTION.template.yaml and COMPILATION_CONTRACT.md are the ordered semantic source-of-truth for registered advanced patterns.
Canonical outcome_edges are semantic edges and must not be emitted as executable routing syntax unless the target compiler explicitly supports them.
Single-successor canonical outcomes lower to next; interactive continuations lower to on_answer.next; binary deterministic branches lower to on_pass/on_fail.
Enum or multi-outcome branches lower to explicit deterministic cascade gates over exact canonical discriminator tokens, with invalid, empty, malformed or multiple discriminator states failing closed.
Model-produced classifications persist the canonical discriminator before deterministic routing.
Every canonical outcome destination must survive lowering exactly; semantic enum branches must never be coerced to different binary PASS/FAIL semantics.
The generated graph must have unique executable IDs, resolved targets, valid routes for every non-terminal and full reachability from graph_contract.entry_node.
Target editor/runtime-plan validation or an equivalent route-semantics validator is mandatory before delivery.
